description: A broad-faced binder's hammer used to strike sections squarely, here to drive old joints flat without cutting or bruising the paper. Its flat crushing blow contrasts with the small-faced glancing strokes of the dedicated backing hammer used to shape the spine.
name: flattening hammer

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter II, p.53. Internet Archive.
Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, New York, 1902; first published 1901), Internet Archive
